title: 第1442章 怒斩上界修士化身第1441章 李卓阳 道友请留步
lines: 要知道，当年他被天中周家合体境后期修士周渊的领域笼罩时，于天地间的联系，断得都没如此的彻底。
也就是说，眼前这具化身的本体境界，至少也是大乘境！
或许，比大乘境还要可怕！！
干瘪老头看到李卓阳惊惧的神色，自然明白对方已经感知到了自己的强大。
于是其嘴角不禁露出了一抹得色，并要调动天地之力，将此人彻底灭杀当场！
然而，令他震惊的一幕出现了。
只见下一瞬，原本在自己强大领域内，已经无法调用任何灵力的人族修士，竟然瞬间动了。
而且，此人的身体还在一刹那完成了突变，变得更加庞大，也更加强大了。
神魔战体！
在对方强大的领域之中，李卓阳丝毫不敢大意，当即便施展出了最强的肉身手段。
不过，这还不够！
当李卓阳神魔战体达到最强之际，只见其右手手臂之上，道道雷霆之力，蓦然闪现，并且快速地朝着其手掌汇聚而去！
顷刻间，李卓阳的右掌仿佛化作了这片天地之间的雷电之源，无限积聚的雷电之力，令其右掌之上，放射出了令人不敢直视的亮光。
玄圣手！
干瘪老头见此，心中陡然察觉到了不妙。
这一刻，他吞噬庞大血食而来的三成实力，丝毫都不敢保留了，体内磅礴的精血之力，疯狂地在其胸前涌现，进而化为了一个血淋淋的巨大血印。
闪瞬间，李卓阳身形便已来到了干瘪老头身前，而后那几乎崩天裂地的玄圣手，轰然间便拍到了巨大血印之上。
玄圣手裹挟的肉身之力以及雷电之力，轰然间便将那血印拍成了一阵血雾。
巨大的声响伴随着冲击波，瞬间传遍方圆百里海面，将海中无数的鱼虾龟蟹，乃至一阶二阶海兽，直接震死。
一时间，海面上各种鱼虾尸体，覆盖了几乎整个海面。
玄圣手光芒散尽，只见干瘪老头噗的一声，吐出了大口精血。
而其身体，也在这一口精血离去的同时，更加干瘪了。
“你……你这蝼蚁，竟敢伤我……”
干瘪老头眼看无法维持化身形态，身形陡然一震，化为了一团由黑色雾气所形成的鲶鱼脑袋。
“带本仙调集仙力，定然让你身死道消！！！”
鲶鱼脑袋眼神之中，一股凛然的杀机，将李卓阳牢牢锁定。
然而，面对这种由神念化成的虚体，李卓阳更是不惧了。
只见其微微一笑，抬手间便从体内空间释放出大量雷电之力，当即便向鲶鱼脑袋笼罩而去。
鲶鱼脑袋见此，脸上不禁一阵抽动。
他是着实没有料到，这位区区有着炼虚境中期修为的人类修士，单靠肉身之力，竟然都能发挥出堪比合体境初期修士的恐怖攻击力！
而且，肉身之力强大也就罢了，此人竟然还能在被自己截断天地沟通的情况下，爆发出如此强横的雷电之力！
早知道此人如此难缠，他又怎么会让此人近身？
content_en:
You must know that when he was enveloped by the realm of Zhou Yuan, a late-stage monk of the Zhou family in the sky, the connection between heaven and earth was not so completely severed.
In other words, the ontological realm of the incarnation in front of me is at least the Mahayana realm!
Perhaps, it is even more terrifying than the Mahayana realm! !
When the wizened old man saw Li Zhuoyang's frightened expression, he naturally understood that the other party had sensed his strength.
So the corner of his mouth couldn't help but reveal a hint of lust, and he wanted to mobilize the power of heaven and earth to completely kill this person on the spot!
However, a scene that shocked him occurred.
In the next moment, the human monk, who was unable to use any spiritual power within his powerful domain, suddenly moved.
Moreover, this person's body also completed a mutation in an instant, becoming larger and more powerful.
God and Demon Battle Body!
In the opponent's powerful field, Li Zhuoyang did not dare to be careless at all, and even used the strongest physical means.
However, this is not enough!
When Li Zhuoyang's divine and demon fighting body reached its strongest, the power of thunder suddenly appeared on his right arm and quickly converged towards his palm!
In an instant, Li Zhuoyang's right palm seemed to turn into the source of thunder and lightning between the heaven and the earth. The infinite accumulation of thunder and lightning power caused a bright light that made people dare not look directly at his right palm.
Xuansheng Hand!
Seeing this, the wizened old man suddenly felt something was wrong.
At this moment, he didn't dare to retain the 30% strength he gained from devouring the huge blood meal. The majestic power of essence and blood in his body surged crazily in his chest, and then turned into a huge bloody blood mark.
In the blink of an eye, Li Zhuoyang's figure had arrived in front of the withered old man, and then the Xuansheng's hand, which almost shattered the sky and the earth, suddenly touched the huge blood mark.
"Boom..."
The physical power and the power of thunder and lightning wrapped in Xuan Sheng's hand suddenly smashed the blood seal into a burst of blood mist.
The huge sound was accompanied by a shock wave, which instantly spread across the sea surface within a hundred miles, killing countless fish, shrimps, turtles, crabs, and even first- and second-order sea beasts in the sea.
For a time, all kinds of fish and shrimp carcasses on the sea covered almost the entire sea surface.
"Pfft..."
The light from Xuan Sheng's hand dissipated, and the withered old man spit out a large mouthful of blood.
And his body, as this mouthful of essence and blood left, became even more shriveled up.
"You... you ant, how dare you hurt me..."
Seeing that the wizened old man could not maintain his incarnation form, his body suddenly shook and turned into a catfish head formed by black mist.
"Take me to mobilize the immortal power, and you will definitely die!!!"
In the eyes of Catfish's head, there was an awe-inspiring murderous intention, locking Li Zhuoyang firmly.
However, Li Zhuoyang was not afraid of this kind of incorporeal body formed by spiritual thoughts.
He smiled slightly, raised his hand, and released a large amount of thunder and lightning power from the space in his body, immediately shrouding the catfish's head.
When Catfish Head saw this, his face couldn't help but twitch.
He really didn't expect that this human monk with a cultivation level in the middle stage of the Void Refining Realm would be able to exert a terrifying attack power comparable to that of a monk in the early stage of the Fusion Realm by relying on the power of his physical body alone!
Moreover, even though his physical body is powerful, this person can actually burst out with such tyrannical thunder and lightning power even though he has cut off the communication between heaven and earth!
If he had known that this person was so difficult, how could he let him get close to him?
title_en: Chapter 1442: Angrily Killing the Incarnation of a Monk from the Upper Realm Chapter 1441: Li Zhuoyang, fellow Taoist, please stay.
